//go:build integration

package integration

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	privateapi "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private"
	privatehandlers "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

type t11ProviderClock struct{}

func (t11ProviderClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Now().UTC() }

type t11ProviderIDs struct{}

func (t11ProviderIDs) NewID() string { return uuid.NewString() }

type t11ProviderFixture struct {
	StudentID          string `json:"student_id"`
	LearningPathID     string `json:"learning_path_id"`
	LearningPathItemID string `json:"learning_path_item_id"`
}

type t11ProviderCounts struct {
	t11ProviderFixture
	Receipts             int   `json:"receipts"`
	Evidence             int   `json:"evidence"`
	Audit                int   `json:"audit"`
	MasteryRows          int   `json:"mastery_rows"`
	MasteryEvidenceCount int   `json:"mastery_evidence_count"`
	Actions              int   `json:"actions"`
	ClosedActions        int   `json:"closed_actions"`
	CompletedItems       int   `json:"completed_items"`
	PathVersion          int64 `json:"path_version"`
}

// TestT11EvidenceHTTPProvider exposes actual registered Student private handlers
// and the PostgreSQL mastery reducer for serialized cross-service delivery proof.
// Identities are synthetic; the dedicated trusted service token is direct internal
// ingress, not JWT authentication or full learner end-to-end verification.
// This harness never migrates or resets the database and retains its UUID rows.
// Run this file alone: the historical integration package has stale API references.
func TestT11EvidenceHTTPProvider(t *testing.T) {
	dsn := os.Getenv("T11_STUDENT_DATABASE_URL")
	if dsn == "" {
		t.Skip("set T11_STUDENT_DATABASE_URL for explicitly isolated migrated proof database")
	}
	token := os.Getenv("T11_STUDENT_INTERNAL_TOKEN")
	readyFile, stopFile, assertionFile := os.Getenv("T11_STUDENT_READY_FILE"), os.Getenv("T11_STUDENT_STOP_FILE"), os.Getenv("T11_STUDENT_ASSERTION_FILE")
	if token == "" || readyFile == "" || stopFile == "" || assertionFile == "" {
		t.Fatal("provider requires dedicated token, ready, stop, and assertion file envs")
	}
	if readyFile == stopFile || readyFile == assertionFile || stopFile == assertionFile {
		t.Fatal("provider control files must be distinct")
	}
	for _, path := range []string{readyFile, stopFile, assertionFile} {
		if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("provider requires fresh control files")
		} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dsn)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid proof database configuration")
	}
	if (cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" && cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "localhost" && cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "::1") || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58998 || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "student_remediation_integration_proof" {
		t.Fatal("requires owned loopback:58998 student_remediation_integration_proof database")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 12*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("cannot connect to isolated Student proof database")
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	if err := pool.Ping(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("cannot ping isolated Student proof database")
	}
	const revisionID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003"
	const stepID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005"
	target := domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "loops", Version: "v1"}
	journey := &postgres.LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	fixtures := make([]t11ProviderFixture, 0, 3)
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		now := time.Now().UTC()
		fixture := t11ProviderFixture{StudentID: uuid.NewString(), LearningPathID: uuid.NewString(), LearningPathItemID: uuid.NewString()}
		path := domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: fixture.LearningPathID, StudentID: fixture.StudentID, CourseID: uuid.NewString(), GoalCode: "go.backend", CurriculumRevision: "t11-delivery-proof-v1", PolicyVersion: domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "Synthetic T11 delivery proof", Status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive, Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{ID: fixture.LearningPathItemID, ReferenceType: "practice", ReferenceID: revisionID, Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap", Targets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{target}}}}
		created, replayed, err := journey.CreateLearningPathIdempotently(ctx, path, repository.LearningPathCreationRequest{IdempotencyKey: uuid.NewString(), PlanningRequestID: uuid.NewString(), RequestHash: strings.Repeat("a", 64)})
		if err != nil || replayed {
			t.Fatalf("seed isolated path: replayed=%v err=%v", replayed, err)
		}
		fixture.LearningPathItemID = created.Items[0].ID
		fixtures = append(fixtures, fixture)
	}
	actions := postgres.LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	handler := &privatehandlers.Handler{PracticeLearningActions: studentuc.PracticeLearningActions{Actions: actions, Clock: t11ProviderClock{}, IDs: t11ProviderIDs{}}, PracticeLearningEvidence: studentuc.ApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidence{Actions: actions, Clock: t11ProviderClock{}}}
	root := chi.NewRouter()
	root.Mount("/internal", privateapi.NewRouter(handler, uuid.NewString(), "", "", token))
	readCounts := func(readCtx context.Context) ([]t11ProviderCounts, error) {
		counts := make([]t11ProviderCounts, 0, len(fixtures))
		for _, f := range fixtures {
			c := t11ProviderCounts{t11ProviderFixture: f}
			err := pool.QueryRow(readCtx, `SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM student_practice_evidence_receipt WHERE student_id=$1),
    (SELECT count(*) FROM student_practice_target_evidence WHERE student_id=$1),
    (SELECT count(*) FROM student_practice_target_mastery_audit WHERE student_id=$1),
    (SELECT count(*) FROM student_target_mastery WHERE student_id=$1),
    (SELECT COALESCE(sum(evidence_count),0) FROM student_target_mastery WHERE student_id=$1),
    (SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_action WHERE student_id=$1),
    (SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_action WHERE student_id=$1 AND lifecycle_status='CLOSED'),
    (SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_path_item WHERE student_learning_path_id=$2 AND status='COMPLETED'),
    (SELECT version FROM student_learning_path WHERE id=$2 AND student_id=$1)`, f.StudentID, f.LearningPathID).Scan(&c.Receipts, &c.Evidence, &c.Audit, &c.MasteryRows, &c.MasteryEvidenceCount, &c.Actions, &c.ClosedActions, &c.CompletedItems, &c.PathVersion)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			counts = append(counts, c)
		}
		return counts, nil
	}
	// Read-only proof instrumentation, limited to owned UUIDs; no mutation shortcut.
	root.Get("/t11/proof/stats", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != token {
			http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
			return
		}
		counts, err := readCounts(r.Context())
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "proof query failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"fixtures": counts})
	})
	server := httptest.NewServer(root)
	defer server.Close()
	writeJSON := func(path string, value any) {
		t.Helper()
		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(value, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = os.WriteFile(path+".tmp", append(data, '\n'), 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = os.Rename(path+".tmp", path); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	writeJSON(readyFile, map[string]any{"base_url": server.URL, "revision_id": revisionID, "target": target, "step_id": stepID, "fixtures": fixtures, "stats_path": "/t11/proof/stats", "retained_rows": true})
	ticker := time.NewTicker(100 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Fatal("provider stop file not received before deadline")
		case <-ticker.C:
			if _, err := os.Stat(stopFile); os.IsNotExist(err) {
				continue
			} else if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			// No deliveries should be in flight after the orchestrator requests stop.
			server.Close()
			counts, err := readCounts(ctx)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			passed := true
			for i, c := range counts {
				want := 1
				if i == 2 {
					want = 0
				}
				if c.Receipts != want || c.Evidence != want || c.Audit != want || c.MasteryRows != want || c.MasteryEvidenceCount != want || c.Actions != want || c.ClosedActions != want || c.CompletedItems != want {
					passed = false
					t.Errorf("fixture %d expected exactly %d completion, got %+v", i, want, c)
				}
				version := int64(3)
				if i == 2 {
					version = 1
				}
				if c.PathVersion != version {
					passed = false
					t.Errorf("fixture %d path version=%d want=%d", i, c.PathVersion, version)
				}
			}
			writeJSON(assertionFile, map[string]any{"passed": passed, "fixtures": counts, "real_student_http": true, "real_student_postgres": true, "synthetic_identities": true, "trusted_internal_ingress": true, "jwt_verified": false, "full_e2e": false, "retained_rows": true})
			return
		}
	}
}
